dependency_repairs: Installed ogb in the MLAgentBench virtual environment.
Installed torch_geometric in the MLAgentBench virtual environment.
Used TORCH_FORCE_NO_WEIGHTS_ONLY_LOAD=1 to work around PyTorch 2.6+ torch.load default compatibility for OGB/PyG processed graph files.
claim_boundary: This is stronger second-official-task feasibility evidence than a pure setup blocker because OGBN-arxiv data download and prepare complete under a documented PyTorch compatibility setting. It is not an official MLAgentBench score because baseline training fails before producing submission.csv.
next_step: Install a PyG neighbor-sampling backend matching torch 2.12 CPU, or pin torch/PyG to an available wheel set, then rerun starter baseline and only then compare a co-pilot-selected branch.
